chunks: [About the Companions of the Holy Prophet]

Look at the people of the Prophet’s family. Adhere to their direction. Follow their footsteps because they would never let you out of guidance, and never throw you into destruction. If they sit down, you sit down, and if they rise up you rise up. Do not go ahead of them, as you would thereby go astray and do not lag behind of them as you would thereby be ruined.
ai.seo_question: How should Muslims follow the Ahl al-Bayt according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this admonition from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the Ahl al-Bayt as the infallible standard of guidance, urging the Companions to maintain a precise middle path—neither preceding them in innovation nor lagging behind in neglect. This directive underscores the Shia doctrine of their authoritative role in preserving the Prophet's legacy, ensuring that the community remains anchored in true faith amidst the changing political landscape of the early Caliphate.
